observations: The three photos show three different sewing machines, not one item.
Photo 0: white and pink portable electric sewing machine with stitch selector dials and a stitch length scale; the brand on the front looks like 'RICCAR' but is small and blurred.
Photo 1: white portable electric sewing machine with a single stitch dial; 'Semco indigo 6' is printed on the front. A Singer machine sits behind it.
Photo 2: white portable electric sewing machine with stitch selector and German/French labels; 'NOVAMATIC NM 868A' is printed on the front.
All three are household (domestic) free-arm machines with built-in motors, not industrial machines: no table, no clutch or servo motor under a table, no industrial head.
All photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji' and 'MARTEX GLOBAL' dealer watermark; the background is a shop with many other machines.
No foot pedal, power cable or machine running is shown in any photo; light dust and handling marks only, no visible cracks.

identity.kind: portable domestic electric sewing machine (household, foreign used)

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1 and 2 all show portable household machines with built-in motors, not industrial machines mounted on a table with a separate motor.

claims.claim: Used for sewing clothes and multipurpose uses
claims.evidence: No clip of any machine sewing; these are basic household machines suited to light fabric.
The machines are electric types, but no photo shows the power cable or foot pedal.

risks.risk: It is unclear which of the three machines is being sold, or whether it is one or several
risks.proof: Seller names the one machine on offer and sends a fresh photo of it with a handwritten note bearing today's date
risks.if_unproven: priced as one machine, the lowest of the three

risks.risk: Motor, gears or stitch mechanism not working
risks.proof: Video of the machine sewing a line on cloth using its foot pedal

risks.risk: Foot pedal and power cable missing; Europe-sourced 230V parts may also be absent or wrong plug
risks.proof: Photo of the machine with its foot pedal and power cable connected

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as bobbin case, bobbins and presser feet
risks.proof: Photo of the bobbin area opened and the accessory box

proof_requests: Which single machine is for sale, with a fresh photo of it and a handwritten note bearing today's date
Video of that machine sewing on cloth driven by its foot pedal
Photo showing the foot pedal and power cable
Photo of the bobbin area and accessories
response.reason: All three photos show portable household electric sewing machines, so the item can be priced at its worst case as one non-working domestic machine; the 'industrial' claim is contradicted by the photos and earns nothing.
